# Anthony Tulk

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male
- **Status:** Deceased
- **Role:** Guard

## Appearance

Anthony Tulk is a middle-aged man with a weathered face and dark, greying hair. He possesses a sturdy build from years of martial training and guard work. He typically wears standard chainmail and dark leather gear bearing the insignia of his house.

## Personality

Anthony is a dutiful, pragmatic guard who prioritizes the safety of his charges above all else. Though stern and reserved on duty, he maintains a quiet loyalty to those he serves. He approaches tense situations with a cautious, methodical mindset.

## Traits

- Dutiful
- Cautious
- Loyal

## Abilities

- Swordsmanship
- Sentry vigilance

## Goals

- Fulfill his duties as a guard and protect his employer

## History

Anthony Tulk serves as a guard stationed during critical operations in the earlier volumes of the series. He is tasked with overseeing security during high-risk escorts and perimeter watches. During a sudden ambush by hostile forces, Tulk attempts to hold the line to allow others to escape. He is ultimately overwhelmed and killed in the line of duty.

## Background by volume

- Served as a veteran guard for several years before entering service in major house operations
